lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance centroids are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The primary lateral grid consists of approximately 7 visible columns with 3 to 5 nodes each, showing a staggered spatial distribution as they progress towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with horizontal ridges; high-luminance blobs are located at these intersections, forming a rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features exhibit a high-contrast gradient, with the dorsal-most ridge defining the boundary between the dark dorsal field and the patterned lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 14 distinct high-intensity pixel clusters, with a higher spatial frequency observed near the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The caudal fin exhibits a significant structural absence of the lower lobe. A small, high-intensity linear artifact is visible at the posterior insertion point of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Cephalic region exhibits a distinct transition to significantly smaller, higher-density pixel clusters (micro-spots) compared to the macro-patterning on the trunk.
